imagemagick_delegates.stdout:
Path: <portable-tools>\delegates.xml

Delegate                Command
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        bpg =>          ""bpgdec" -b 16 -o "%o" "%i""
        dot =>          ""dot" -Tsvg "%i" -o "%o""
        dvi =>          ""dvips" -q -o "%o" "%i""
        eps<=>pdf        ""gswin64c.exe" -q -dQUIET -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -dNOPROMPT -dMaxBitmap=500000000 "-sDEVICE=pdfwrite" "-sOutputFile=%o" "-f%i""
        eps<=>ps         ""gswin64c.exe" -q -dQUIET -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -dNOPROMPT -dMaxBitmap=500000000 -dAlignToPixels=0 -dGridFitTT=2 "-sDEVICE=ps2write" "-sOutputFile=%o" "-f%i""
        hpg =>          ""hp2xx" -q -m eps -f "%o" "%i""
       hpgl =>          ""hp2xx" -q -m eps -f "%o" "%i""
        htm =>          ""html2ps" -U -o "%o" "%i""
       html =>          ""html2ps" -U -o "%o" "%i""
       ilbm =>          ""ilbmtoppm" "%i" > "%o""
        jpg<= lep        ""lepton" "%i" "%o""
        jxr =>          "cmd.exe /c (move "%i" "%i.jxr" >nul) & ("JXRDecApp.exe" -i "%i.jxr" -o "%o.tiff") & (move "%i.jxr" "%i" >nul) & (move "%o.tiff" "%o" >nul)"
        lep =>          ""lepton" "%i" "%o""
        pdf<=>eps        ""gswin64c.exe" -q -dQUIET -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -dNOPROMPT -dMaxBitmap=500000000 -dAlignToPixels=0 -dGridFitTT=2 "-sDEVICE=eps2write" "-sPDFPassword=%a" "-sOutputFile=%o" "-f%i""
        pdf<=>ps         ""gswin64c.exe" -q -dQUIET -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -dNOPROMPT -dMaxBitmap=500000000 -dAlignToPixels=0 -dGridFitTT=2 "-sDEVICE=ps2write" "-sPDFPassword=%a" "-sOutputFile=%o" "-f%i""
        png<= bpg        ""bpgenc" -b 12 -q "%~" -o "%o" "%i""
        pnm<= ilbm       ""ppmtoilbm" -24if "%i" > "%o""
         ps<=>eps        ""gswin64c.exe" -q -dQUIET -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -dNOPROMPT -dMaxBitmap=500000000 -dAlignToPixels=0 -dGridFitTT=2 "-sDEVICE=eps2write" "-sOutputFile=%o" "-f%i""
         ps<=>pdf        ""gswin64c.exe" -q -dQUIET -dSAFER -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -dNOPROMPT -dMaxBitmap=500000000 -dAlignToPixels=0 -dGridFitTT=2 "-sDEVICE=pdfwrite" "-sOutputFile=%o" "-f%i""
      shtml =>          ""html2ps" -U -o "%o" "%i""
        svg =>          ""rsvg-convert" --dpi-x %x --dpi-y %y -o "%o" "%i""
       tiff<= jxr        "cmd.exe /c (move "%i" "%i.tiff" >nul) & ("JXREncApp.exe" -i "%i.tiff" -o "%o.jxr" -q %Q) & (move "%i.tiff" "%i" >nul) & (move "%o.jxr" "%o" >nul)"
       tiff<= wdp        "cmd.exe /c (move "%i" "%i.tiff" >nul) & ("JXREncApp.exe" -i "%i.tiff" -o "%o.jxr" -q %Q) & (move "%i.tiff" "%i" >nul) & (move "%o.jxr" "%o" >nul)"
video:decode =>          ""ffmpeg" -nostdin -loglevel error -i "%s" -an -f rawvideo -y %s "%s""
        wdp =>          "cmd.exe /c (move "%i" "%i.jxr" >nul) & ("JXRDecApp.exe" -i "%i.jxr" -o "%o.pnm") & (move "%i.jxr" "%i" >nul) & (move "%o.pnm" "%o" >nul)"
